verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API uses HTTP Basic auth with a per-team API key, and test teams act as separate tenants with their own keys. That is tenant isolation, not scoped or least-privilege credentials. Nothing in the pack shows permission scopes, endpoint-restricted keys, read-only keys or agent-specific credentials, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
